scope: Minimal corrections to outputs-02 only; no code, no new platform, no process supervisor, no new CI job. Prior fixes D45-R01..R06 and the revision-04 D45-S01..S06 fixes are preserved, except that the S03 retry-safety rule is made more conservative as described below.

responses.change: An installed-distribution smoke check (scripts/dist-smoke.sh) is added to the existing required `static` job and to the H1 completion criteria. It runs `uv build`, installs the wheel into a fresh venv without PYTHONPATH, and runs the installed `loopctl inspect --feature f-missing` outside the source checkout, which must exit 5 with valid JSON. It also confirms `import loopctl.tools` works from the installed package. The wheel sha256 and the command/exit are recorded, and a failure blocks H1. The check is owned by task 1.1 and re-run in 15.2.
locations: outputs-02/validation.md V-DIST row, H1 completion, §4 static job

responses.change: Checkout is now event-aware. PR builds check out `github.event.pull_request.head.sha` and push builds `github.sha`. After checkout the job verifies `git rev-parse HEAD` against the intended SHA (a mismatch fails the job) and uploads a `tested-sha` artifact. The G3 collector credits a check for `source: head` only when the check-run metadata head_sha==H and tested-sha==H; it does not assume checkout changes check-run metadata and never silently relabels a merge-commit M. An H≠M PR test case is added to the gates task and the gh observe tool task.

Bootstrap delivery gates for the controller's own H1 PR (D39) are now separated from H2 self-hosting. Task 15.4 and validation §3a add a coordinator-assembled, independently reviewed record in docs/validation/h1/bootstrap-gates.md. G1 is judged on original Red/Green plus head CI Green, G2 on the independent review of the same head/base/doc digests, and G3 on the D11-approved set plus a policy_change binding, which may now be recorded during H1, with every check success and tested-sha==H. G3 is unknown only when approval, binding or valid check evidence is missing. Nothing is granted automatically. Claims about H2 runtime, capability and self-hosted E2E stay pending, and S1 closure stays with the reviewer. The check set remains unapproved today.
locations: outputs-02/validation.md §1, H1 completion note, §3a, §4 closing paragraph, V-H2-05

responses.change: The retry-safety rule is made conservative for remote operations. For gh_pr_ensure and gh_publish_*, a dead local process plus an absent marker is not proof, because a previously sent GitHub request can still publish later. Retry is allowed only when the begin owner recorded definite non-delivery, or when a native idempotency guarantee has been confirmed against the real API in H2 (not assumed before then). Otherwise the result is outcome_unknown, Blocked for a human. Cessation plus absence stays valid only for local synchronous worktree_create. The DUR-06 spec text, a gh_publish test case in tasks 4.1, and the V-H1-13 threshold are updated. No process supervisor is added.
